description.zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口[ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~)或[ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to query the task flow ID.

description.zh: 节点在图上的显示位置。
description.en: The position of the node on the Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).
The name of the node that you want to create.
The output variables configured for the task.

description.zh: 任务节点类型，取值请参见[NodeType参数说明](~~424705~~)。
description.en: The type of the node that you want to create. For more information about the valid values for this parameter, see [NodeType parameter](~~424705~~).

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the [Manage DMS tenants](~~181330~~) topic.

description.zh: 节点变量（时间变量配置）。
description.en: The time variables configured for the node.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-task --tid 3000 --dag-id 7000 --node-name zhttest --node-type NORMAL_SQL --node-content test --time-variables test --node-output test --graph-param test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise CreateTask --region cn-hangzhou --NodeName zhttest --TimeVariables test --NodeType NORMAL_SQL --Tid 3000 --DagId 7000 --NodeOutput test --NodeContent test --GraphParam test
